name: @example-providers/sms-relay-a
description: A channel adapter for an SMS relay that takes JSON and signs its callbacks with HMAC-SHA256 (D159).

TOKEN.description: The relay's API token, which also signs its callbacks.

SENDER.description: The number messages are sent from; the relay's default when unset.

CALLER_KEY.description: The key the relay calls the app with, to read the deliveries it sent (#744): the API resolves a request bearing it to this provider's principal, which may relay messages and nothing else. An environment that lets the relay call nothing leaves it unset.
